title: Limiting Behavior of a Class of Hermitian Yang--Mills Metrics, II: Exponential Approximation
summary: This paper is a sequel to [9], where the first-named author constructed a family of approximate Hermitian Yang--Mills metrics $H_{0,ε}$ on stable rank-two holomorphic vector bundles arising from double spectral covers over the product of two one-dimensional complex tori. We prove that these approximate metrics give an all-order, exponentially accurate asymptotic description of the exact Hermitian Yang--Mills metrics in the large Kähler limit.
